title.narrative: JPO China 2025 Culture Unit/UNESCO Office in Nairobi

description.narrative:
Within this context, the JPO will assist in the overall implementation and management of the UNESCO Culture Programme in Eastern Africa, with a particular focus on the 1972 Convention concerning the Protection of the World Cultural and Natural Heritage, the 2003 Convention for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage, as well as cross-cutting culture initiatives related to climate change, sustainable urban development and tourism. The tasks include the following: 1. Contribute to the planning, project development and implementation of activities related to the UNESCO culture unit, and support the cooperation and communication with the stakeholders. 2. Contribute to visibility and awareness raising of activities by planning and tracking monthly/weekly culture activities in the region, writing and publishing news releases and articles for the UNESCO Nairobi website, and preparing social media posts for the UNESCO Nairobi Office official pages, in close cooperation with the Public Information unit.
3. Participate in resource mobilization efforts by supporting the preparation of proposals, reports and presentations, which may be regional or country-specific, as assigned by the Culture Programme Specialist. 4. Support the administration of activities and events including logistics planning, implementation, outreach and communication to promote the work of the Culture Sector in Eastern Africa 5. Participate in weekly briefing meetings with the Culture Programme Specialist in Nairobi and monthly coordination meetings with cultural officers in the Eastern Africa region. 6. Support the preparation and implementation of online meetings/workshops/conferences, including preparing a list of participants, PPT presentations, technical preparations and managing PPTs during the meetings. 7. Carry out other assignments by the Culture Programme Specialist as needed.
